n3f9e67e551.headline: Alberto Fernández, on the purchase of US$ 200 per month:
n3f9e67e551.summary: Argentine President Alberto Fernández acknowledged the government is considering limiting monthly purchases of US dollars to $200.
n3f9e67e551.why: Currency controls affect foreign exchange markets and capital flows in Argentina, a country with a history of currency volatility and inflation.
n3f9e67e551.why_moved: Potential dollar purchase restrictions increase uncertainty around Argentina's currency controls, affecting the peso's value.
